name: CSE WARP V17 — parité de luminosité multi-backend
purpose: Mesurer la luminosité des mêmes captures et vues entre DX11 Raster, Vulkan Raster et LumaTrace, sans modifier automatiquement l'exposition ni les moteurs.

backends.label: LumaTrace BVH4
backends.variantContains: LumaTrace BVH4 GPU lighting + Raster preview/readback

metrics.primary: mean Rec.709 luminance, decoded from sRGB PNG values to linear light
metrics.regions: whole frame plus a normalized 3x3 screen grid
metrics.comparison: relative to the matching D3D11 Raster capture; report only, no automatic correction

acceptance.vulkan: whole-frame mean within ±5% of D3D11; inspect regional rows before deciding
acceptance.lumatrace: whole-frame mean within ±10% of D3D11; treat as diagnostic because its lighting model may differ
acceptance.important: thresholds are first-pass review bands, not a claim that unlike lighting algorithms must be pixel-identical

limitations: This first suite measures the package's existing scene and cameras; it does not create synthetic material-chart scenes.
CPU, Compute, and low-resolution diagnostics are intentionally excluded from cross-backend brightness parity.
The campaign must run on a real GPU for useful backend comparison; WARP is functional coverage only.
PNG transfer is assumed sRGB for the linear-luminance calculation; the report also preserves encoded-space-independent relative diagnostics only through this declared assumption.
